orders.title: Delegation of Executive and Administrative Authorities to the Lieutenant Governor
orders.issuer: TallCloud_II, Governor of the State of Mayflower
orders.text:
By virtue of the executive authority vested in me as Governor of the State of Mayflower under the Constitution and laws of this State, and for the purpose of ensuring the efficient administration of the executive branch, facilitating intergovernmental coordination, and providing for the orderly execution of state policy, I hereby order as follows:

Section 1. Delegation of Executive Authority.

(a) The Lieutenant Governor of Mayflower is hereby designated as the principal administrative representative of the Governor and is authorized to exercise delegated executive and administrative authority under the continuing supervision and direction of the Governor.

(b) The Lieutenant Governor shall have authority to coordinate and supervise the general administrative operations of executive departments, agencies, and offices; convene meetings of executive officials; request reports and information; review governmental operations; issue binding administrative instructions and directives consistent with established state policy; and oversee the implementation of executive orders and other directives issued by the Governor.

(c) The Lieutenant Governor is further authorized to coordinate interdepartmental activities, establish administrative objectives, oversee executive branch recruitment initiatives, review applications for governmental employment or appointment, evaluate prospective officers, and submit recommendations concerning appointments, promotions, removals, and vacancies. The Lieutenant Governor may coordinate governmental development initiatives, prepare proposals for the establishment or improvement of state institutions, and supervise the implementation of administrative programs authorized by law.

(d) The Lieutenant Governor may represent the Governor in meetings, discussions, and official communications with executive officials, legislative officers, and other governmental representatives. Such authority shall include coordinating with the Senate concerning legislative proposals, executive appointments, governmental reports, and matters of mutual concern, as well as assisting in the development of the administrative framework necessary for the effective organization and operation of the Senate, without interfering with its constitutional independence.

(e) The Lieutenant Governor may issue administrative memoranda, instructions, and directives necessary to carry out the authorities delegated herein, which shall be binding upon executive branch officials to the extent permitted by law. The Lieutenant Governor may also undertake such additional administrative responsibilities as the Governor may assign from time to time.

(f) Nothing in this Order shall authorize the Lieutenant Governor to issue executive orders, exercise the veto or clemency powers, make appointments or removals reserved to the Governor, exercise supreme command of the Mayflower National Guard, interfere with the independent operational or investigative functions of the State Police, or exercise any authority exclusively vested in another constitutional officer. The Lieutenant Governor shall not abolish or reorganize any state department or agency, enter into binding agreements on behalf of the State, or further delegate the authorities conferred herein without authorization from the Governor and compliance with applicable law.

(g) All authority delegated pursuant to this Order shall remain subject to the Constitution and laws of Mayflower and the continuing supervision of the Governor, who shall retain ultimate executive authority and may review, modify, suspend, or revoke any delegation or administrative action to the extent permitted by law.

Section 2. Effective Date.

All officers and employees of the executive branch are hereby directed to cooperate with the Lieutenant Governor in the lawful exercise of the authorities delegated under this Order.

This Order shall take effect immediately upon issuance and shall remain in force until amended, superseded, or revoked by the Governor.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have hereunto set my hand and caused this Executive Order to be issued under the authority of the Office of the Governor of Mayflower, this 2nd day of November, 2026.

TallCloud_II
Governor of the State of Mayflower
orders.notes: The source document's cover gives the date as November, 2026; the execution clause specifies November 2, 2026.
